directive.quote: Own Workshop main repair and shared tool packaging

old_copy.deleted_with: The old meeting-ledger path is absent from published main; the exact committed source slice remains in history.

preserve: Pending hearing is polled through the original loop, with the original elapsed-time ceiling and timeout outcome.
The clock, status reader, sleep and polling settings remain explicit inputs.
allowed_deltas: Wrap the exact loop in an exported function receiving its former ambient values and returning its flushed result.
The asynchronous record-door adapter refreshes status before each core condition check, maps liveness and heard-until into pending, and bounds the final sleep to the existing remaining wait.
banned_substitutions: Claiming the old hearing wait was invented by the record-door adapter.
Another polling loop in the adapter or a sleep past the caller's wait bound.
